standard: Capstone Format & Scorecard · consolidate & celebrate, never a test · score_capstone PASS
note: Chapter 5 grand graduation, and the close of the whole 4-18 journey. The Reinforce beat for Chapter 5: spaced, varied, joyful retrieval of the chapter's nine big truths across six threads (B, C, D, E, F, G), wrapped as a graduation party. Canvas looks back across ages 4-18. Recap and playback reuse only Chapter 5's already-built games (g29, g30, g31, g32, g33, g34, g35, g42, g36); no new content. One of the two grand graduations (with c8). Previews Chapter 6 (College, the start of the adult journey). No scores, no fail-states, no competition; sticker economy only.
arrival: Lensy: look how far you've come. Not just this chapter, the whole way, from a small kid naming feelings to a near-adult ready for the world. This chapter you took real ownership: your choices and your future, your health and your status, consent, identity, leadership, changing what's unfair, your rights, real-life skills, and reading the whole information world. Let's take a calm, proud walk back through everything you can now do, and everything you've grown into.
canvasPayoff: The Ready for the World canvas opens on a sunrise over a whole landscape, and as it brightens, the entire journey lights up behind you: the Friendship Garden of your earliest years, the Explorer's map, the Growing Up world, the night city of Reading Relationships, and now this chapter's skyline rising tallest of all. One by one your nine Chapter 5 stickers ignite like windows in that skyline, and then every chapter you've ever finished glows together, ages 4 to 18, a whole world you built. Your nine stickers rise into the dawn as a constellation called Ready for the World.

recap.bigTruth: Your body and your future are yours to plan, you have the right to decide if and when, and the knowledge to do it well.
Knowing your status is strength, it's routine, private and protective; treatment works, and the only thing to fear is stigma.
Real intimacy is mutual, enthusiastic, ongoing, freely-given consent, every time and both ways.
Love and identity live on a spectrum, and every point on it is natural and deserves respect.
You can lead, quietly or out loud; everyone has a way to lift others and lead with respect.
You can change what's unfair, ordinary people taking small actions is how norms actually shift.
Your rights are yours, the law protects you, and there are real, reachable routes to help and justice.
You're ready for real life, money, work, time and stress are learnable skills, and asking for help is one of them.
You can read the machine, decode the feed, the fakes and yourself, and keep learning for life. Unlearn, Relearn, Grow.

playback.frame: Your Ready for the World constellation, nine stickers from a whole chapter, and the crown of the whole journey. Tap any star to revisit what you grew into.
playback.celebrate: Nine stars in your sky, and a whole journey behind them. Look how far you've come.

playback.frame: One more from Mutual, just for the joy of knowing your read. Swipe up for real, mutual consent.
playback.cue: An enthusiastic yes from both people. A 'maybe, I'm not sure' treated as a yes. A yes that can be changed at any time.
playback.up: Freely given, both ways, and never assumed.
playback.celebrate: Mutual every time, you've got this.

playback.frame: From Decoded, spot the trick one more time, for the satisfaction of seeing straight through it.

scene.text: A pre-ticked box quietly signing you up
A clear, honest choice with a real 'no thanks'
A fake countdown rushing your decision

playback.why: You read the dark patterns now, the pre-ticked box and the fake urgency, and you're hard to nudge.
playback.celebrate: You can read the machine. That's a skill for life.

playback.frame: One more from Change Makers, for the feeling of it. Something unfair is happening in your group, and everyone's gone quiet.

options.text: Take one small, real action, you don't need to fix it all alone
options.consequence: You shift the moment; small actions are how norms move.

options.text: Decide it's not your place to say anything
options.consequence: One small action from an ordinary person is exactly how things change, and you can be that person.

playback.debrief: Change rarely comes from one hero; it comes from ordinary people taking small actions. You're one of them now.
playback.celebrate: Changemaker, you can move what's unfair.

playback.frame: From Spectrum, a gentle sort, just to feel how clear it is to you now.

items.text: Treating one way as the only normal

playback.celebrate: Every point on the spectrum, respected. That's who you are now.

playback.frame: From Justice League, match a need to where help actually lives, the routes you now carry.

pairs.left: Online abuse or a fake of you

playback.celebrate: You know the routes now. Rights you can actually claim.

playback.frame: One more from Life Ready, for real life. Your first month managing your own money, and it's tighter than you thought.

options.text: Make a simple plan and ask someone who knows for tips
options.consequence: You steady it; budgeting and asking for help are both real skills.

options.text: Hope it sorts itself out and tell no one
options.consequence: A simple plan plus asking for help is the grown-up move, and asking is a strength, not a weakness.

playback.debrief: Money, time and stress are all learnable, and asking for help is one of the most capable things you can do.
playback.celebrate: Ready for real life, and you don't have to do it alone.

playback.frame: From Status: Know It, one more myth to clear, for the calm of knowing the truth.

myth.un: Only certain people need to know their status.
myth.re: Knowing your status is routine, private and for everyone; it's strength, not shame.

playback.celebrate: Knowing is strength. You carry that calmly now.

playback.frame: From My Choices, My Future, swipe up for everything that's truly yours to decide.
playback.cue: Whether and when. Your own plans and timing. Your body and your future.
playback.up: Mine to decide, with the knowledge to do it well.
playback.celebrate: Your choices, your future. You're ready to own them.

reflect.prompt: Lensy: look how far you've come, all the way from naming feelings as a small kid to here. What feels different about how you see yourself and the world now?
options: I can read the world clearly
I know my rights and choices
reflect.affirm: That growth is real, and you did it yourself, year after year.

reflect.prompt: Of everything this chapter, which idea will you carry into adulthood with you?
reflect.affirm: Whatever you carry, it's yours now, and it goes with you.

reflect.prompt: The biggest lesson of the whole journey: learning never stops, and that's a good thing. Does it feel like something you can keep doing for life?
reflect.affirm: You can. You've been doing it for fifteen years, and now you carry the power yourself.

reflect.prompt: As you step toward the world, what are you most ready for?
reflect.affirm: Whatever you chose, you're more ready than you know, and Lensy is proud of you.

celebration.certificate: This certifies that you are Ready for the World, a graduate of Chapter 5 and of the whole SwipeEd journey, ages 4 to 18. You own your choices and your future, you hold the facts about your health and know that knowing your status is strength, you live consent as mutual and respect every identity on the spectrum, you lead and you change what's unfair, you know your rights and how to claim them, you carry real-life skills and the courage to ask for help, and you can read the whole information world and keep learning for life. You've grown a great deal, across fifteen years, and you did it yourself. Unlearn. Relearn. Grow.
celebration.stickerBook: All nine Chapter 5 stickers now blaze in your Ready for the World constellation, crowned by a golden graduation star. Beneath it, every chapter sticker you've earned since age 4 glows together, the whole journey, complete.

preview: Next, Chapter 6: College (ages 18-22). The kids' journey is complete, and the adult one begins, leaving home, independence, real relationships and choices of your own. It goes deeper and more real, always at your own pace, and Lensy is still right beside you.
share: This whole journey is yours, so this is your call: if you'd like, share one thing you're proud of growing into with a grown-up you trust, maybe someone who's watched you grow up. Or simply hold it for yourself, that's completely okay too. Either way, you've earned this.
